Locates the merge-group CI run that the triggering workflow_run started at the same head: at most 30 reads 2 s apart. workflow_run gives this job only the policy-check run, not the CI run, and glaeda-gh does not exist in CI.

The fail-fast itself: it reads the merge-group CI run every 20 s to cancel it at the first failed job, which no GitHub event reports to another workflow. Bounded by the job's timeout-minutes and by the run completing; only merge groups start it.

Runs on user machines and nightly legs without glaeda-gh.

A local proof of the presence worker: waits for its own SSE transcript to show the alarm-driven offline event, bounded by a 90 s deadline after the last heartbeat. No GitHub call, and it runs on a developer machine that may lack glaeda-gh.
